description: This file defines the interface IControlClientServerInternal, which is an internal server-side control client interface in the Rialto project. It inherits from IControlClient and adds a pure virtual method ping(uint32_t id) for health checks.

classes.name: IControlClientServerInternal
classes.description: An abstract base class for internal control client communication, providing a ping method for health checks.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: A pure virtual method for sending a ping notification to check system health, requiring implementation in derived classes.
